text:
eli: quick design pulse 0 0 prototyping a compact footer for streaming chat: small token meter + stop/regenerate cluster + optional prompt quick-insert. prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-stream-footer-proto. want takes on: wording, whether meter auto-hides, prompt library placement, and a11y behavior.

nadia: nice direction. i'm leaning footer (next to send) for discoverability. if it's in the rail people might miss it while composing.

rahul: backend reality: we don't guarantee resume semantics. so 'Pause' would be misleading. recommend 'Stop' (clear partial output). we can add a separate 'Hold' feature later if we support KV resume.

eli: agreed on 'Stop'. microcopy idea for tooltip: "Stop response — discards partial output". keeps expectations clear.

tess: token meter thoughts: show while streaming, allow an opt-in persistent mode in settings for power users. add a tiny "Tokens" sublabel under the pill to clarify.

access-bot: accessibility checklist suggestions:
- token counter: aria-live=\"polite\" with debounce (recommend 500ms) to avoid screen reader spam
- streaming pulse: aria-hidden=\"true\" so it doesn't announce visual animation
- stop button: explicit aria-label: "Stop response and discard partial output"
- final announcement: role=\"status\" text: "Response complete. X tokens used."

nadia: visual contrast warning: token pill on light theme fails AA. propose bg #0F172A + text #FFFFFF or a 1px neutral border.

rahul: keyboard flow: don't steal focus on stream start; ensure stop is reachable via one extra Tab from send. add Esc as a shortcut to stop. Also add aria-pressed only if it becomes a toggle.

eli: prompt library: don't mix heavy prompt browsing into the footer. keep quick-insert as a compact icon in the footer (opens a popover) but keep full library in the left rail. that way regen can show recent prompts inline without launching the full library.

nadia: regen label: 'Regenerate' is standard. consider a chevron to show quick actions: 'Regenerate', 'Regenerate with variations', 'Open prompt'.

access-bot: additional a11y nit: debounce announcements at most once per 500ms and always announce final token count on completion. ensure animations respect prefers-reduced-motion.

eli: will update the comp with: footer placement, 'Stop' label + tooltip, token pill contrast fix, tokens sublabel, debounce 500ms, Esc shortcut, quick-insert popover (not full library). i'll post updated screenshots shortly. thanks! :sparkles:
